column2: Exit towards Europaplatz and board tram M5 (dir. Hohenschönhausen), M8 (dir. Ahrensfelde), or M10 (dir. Warschauer Straße). Ride 2 stops to U Naturkundemuseum.
Exit towards Europaplatz / Invalidenstraße, turn right, and follow Invalidenstraße past the Museum für Naturkunde (~10–12 minutes).
